jobs.title: Sr .NET Full stack developer
jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

We are looking for a hands\-on and technically sound Senior .NET developer for Design, develop, test, and deploy .NET applications.

 **What you'll do**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy .NET applications (web, desktop, or services).
* Lead or contribute to **upgrade, development and migration projects**, including transitioning from older .NET Framework versions to .NET Core/.NET 6\+.
* UI development using Angular JS, Waypoint, Stencil JS, Micro frontend architecture.
* Analyze and refactor legacy codebases to improve performance and maintainability.
* Develop and optimize complex **SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and database schemas**.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to define software requirements and deliver solutions.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.
* Participate in code reviews and follow best practices in software development.
* Ensure application security, scalability, and responsiveness.

 **What you'll bring**

* 8\+ Years of Proven experience as a .NET Developer or Application Developer.
* .NET/.NET core, React, Angular, SQL server
* Accessibility compliance validated through approved automation tooling, including Deque where required by client
* Unit test cases, code coverage up to 80\-85%
* Documentation sufficient to support code readability, maintainability, and operational handoff
* Secure coding practices and remediation of identified vulnerabilities within approved scope
* High\-performance code consistent with client standard
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proficiency in C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, and .NET Core/.NET 6\+.
* **Hands\-on experience with SQL Server**, including writing complex queries, performance tuning, and database design.
* Experience in **upgrading legacy .NET applications** and migrating to modern architectures.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming (OOP).
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience with version control systems like Git.
* Experience with AWS Cloud.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

 **Soft Skills**

* Ability to lead by example with a hands\-on, proactive approach.
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Strong communication skills to interact with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Commitment to continuous improvement and team development.

**Phenom Intro:**
 Our purpose is to help a billion people find the right work! Phenom is an AI\-Powered talent experience platform that is redefining the HR tech space. We have grown into a global organization with offices in 6 countries and over 1,500 employees. As an HR tech unicorn organization, innovation, creativity, and agentic AI are in our DNA. Come help us make every talent moment Phenomenal!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Product Manager to lead our B2C Applied AI Platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Product Strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for our B2C AI platform and consumer features.
* Feature Delivery: Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-driven features from idea to launch.
* User Experience: Work with designers to create intuitive, engaging, and ethical AI interactions.
* Data \& Metrics: Track product performance, user retention, and engagement to guide decisions.
* Cross\-functional Leadership: Partner with engineering, research, design, and marketing teams


**What You've Done**
* Experience: 3\+ years in product management building B2C software or consumer apps.
* AI Knowledge: Strong understanding of generative AI, large language models, or machine learning capabilities and limits.
* Data Skills: Ability to analyze user data and define success metrics.
* Communication: Excellent skills in explaining complex technical concepts to non\-technical teams.


**Benefits**
 We want you to be your best self and to pursue your passions!
   

  

* Health and wellness benefits/programs to support holistic employee health.
* Flexible hours and working schedules, as well as parental leave for new parents.
* Growing organization with career pathing and development opportunities.
* Tons of perks and extras in every location for all Phenoms!


**Diversity, Equity, \& Inclusion:** 
 Our commitment to diversity runs deep! Diversity is essential to building phenomenal teams, products, and customer experiences. Phenom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer taking collective action to build a more inclusive environment where every candidate and employee feels welcomed. We recognize there is more to be done.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary** 




 As an Associate Product Manager at Alacriti, you will drive the vision, roadmap, and development of our cloud\-native money movement and payments platform. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable, performant, and developer\-friendly payment solutions that delight users and accelerate digital transformation for our financial clients. We are seeking candidates with 3\+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of owning platform, API, or developer\-facing products end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Key Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Develop the long\-term vision and strategy for the product and create and execute on a compelling roadmap
* Build deep user empathy with Alacriti’s clients and partners, understanding global payment industry trends and competitors' offerings to influence the roadmap effectively
* Collaborate with engineering, design and other teams to jointly shape product experiences that delight end\-users
* Ensure we are building a reliable, performant platform, including system reliability, API extensibility, and latency
* Use metrics to inform point of view and leverage analytics to measure success
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, adoption and margins
* Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility
* Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform\-level problems


- 


**Who you are** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 



  




* You are a product builder who can move easily between a user’s hardest problem, the business opportunity behind it, and the product decisions needed to solve it.
* You have worked on technically complex products \- such as APIs, developer tools, shared platform capabilities, or core product experiences \- but you do not build tech/platform for its own sake. You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.
* You are opinionated, thoughtful, and execution\-oriented. You can focus a team on the few decisions that matter most, create momentum in ambiguous situations, and ship products that raise the bar for both quality and impact.


- 


**Minimum Requirements** 




  




* 3\+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time owning platform, API, or developer\-facing products end to end
* Demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end: setting strategy, driving execution, and measuring outcomes
* Strong analytical instincts and comfort defining the measurement framework before you ship
* Clear written communication and the ability to build alignment across functions and levels


- 


**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
* Experience productizing bespoke or custom solutions into broadly available platform capabilities
* A track record of making well\-judged foundational investments ahead of user demand

jobs.description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 Are you passionate about building secure, scalable, and automated cloud networking solutions at enterprise scale? As a Senior Technical Product Manager within Optum's Public Cloud organization, you will play a pivotal role in driving the evolution of our multi\-cloud networking capabilities across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with engineering teams, cloud architects, security leaders, and application teams to modernize networking experiences that accelerate cloud adoption while ensuring compliance, reliability, and operational excellence. You will help define requirements, drive prioritization, and execute strategic networking initiatives that enable thousands of developers and hundreds of cloud workloads across the enterprise.

**Primary Responsibilities**

+ Own and drive specific cloud networking product areas within the Public Cloud portfolio, including connectivity, ingress/egress, service networking, network security, traffic management, DNS, and hybrid cloud networking

+ Monitor product health, adoption metrics, reliability measures, and customer satisfaction indicators
+ Support release planning, testing, rollout strategies, and operational readiness activities
+ Drive issue resolution and continuous improvement initiatives through customer feedback and operational insights

* Stakeholder Management and Collaboration (20%)
+ Serve as a trusted partner to engineering managers, architects, security teams, and application stakeholders
+ Facilitate alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities and objectives
+ Communicate roadmap progress, delivery updates, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes to leadership
+ Support portfolio\-level planning, quarterly business reviews, and strategic initiatives
+ Champion customer\-focused product development and data\-driven decision making

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications (8\-12\+ years):**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of product management experience with technical infrastructure, cloud platform, networking, or enterprise technology products
* 3\+ years of experience working with public cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, and/or GCP
* Experience working with cloud\-native networking services such as Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, Cloud DNS, Azure DNS, Application Gateway, Load Balancers, and related technologies
* Experience collaborating with engineering teams using Agile methodologies including Scrum and Kanban
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, private connectivity, VPNs, and hybrid networking

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Content Framework

jobs.description:
We're looking for an analytical and strategic
 **Product Manager** 
 for AI Content Framework to lead vision, strategy, and execution across our AI\-driven product portfolio, acting as the connector between commercial stakeholders and our advanced AI engineering team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with business leaders, subject matter experts, and end\-users to uncover and document detailed business requirements
* Apply an AI\-informed lens to business problems, deciding whether deterministic software, traditional ML, or generative AI/agentic workflows offer the right solution
* Build and communicate a product roadmap that balances quick business wins against long\-term architectural sustainability
* Break down major product features into detailed Work Breakdown Structures alongside the AI Development Lead
* Produce clear, value\-focused Epics and User Stories, with Acceptance Criteria that reflect the unpredictable nature of AI outputs
* Curate and rank the product backlog according to ROI, user impact, and dependencies flagged by engineering
* Turn business rules and domain expertise into logic engineers can use for agent prompts, tools, and cognitive routing
* Set success metrics for AI agents together with engineering, covering benchmarks, evaluation datasets, and feedback loops
* Represent the customer's perspective in standups, sprint planning, and sprint reviews


**Requirements**
* 10\-15 years of IT experience, including a strong background in Product Management with ownership of roadmaps and vision
* Solid history serving as Product Owner or Product Manager within Agile or SAFE frameworks
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, function calling, and multi\-agent orchestration
* Familiarity with AI Solutions design and AI Content Framework development
* Ability to manage AI\-related risks
* A track record of mapping processes, spotting bottlenecks, and calculating automation ROI
* Experience handling non\-deterministic software lifecycles where AI behavior isn't always predictable
* History of turning large enterprise requirements into staged, incremental deliveries via MVP methods
* Skill in bridging technical AI limitations and business context for different audiences


**Nice to have**
* Experience as Product Owner or Manager for data science, ML, or generative AI offerings
* CSPO or PSPO certification
* A Business or Systems Analysis background with later focus on AI/ML

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* Experience working in data, enterprise, platform or infrastructure.
* Experience working in a geographically distributed team with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex data platforms, drafting detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), and executing long\-term product roadmaps.

**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 As a Product Manager for the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), you will drive the direction to transform Google’s data landscape into an AI\-ready ecosystem. You will lead the development of advanced semantic and reasoning capabilities, such as hybrid search, enterprise knowledge graphs, and GraphRAG, to unify our currently fragmented data space. By bridging structured and unstructured sources, you will enable autonomous agents to execute high\-stakes business workflows with deterministic accuracy and safety. You will collaborate across cross\-functional domains to drive product\-market fit, ensuring our platform provides the secure, governed, and certified data foundation required to power Google’s next generation of agentic intelligence.
   

  

 At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

* Drive the platform's goal by balancing immediate operational needs with a clear roadmap for an AI\-ready, unified enterprise data ecosystem.
* Generate and define detailed product requirements and feature specifications to solve complex data fragmentation and governance challenges.
* Partner with business units to align dependencies and ensure the platform meets wide\-ranging enterprise requirements.
* Engage directly with domain owners to lead platform adoption, optimize common capabilities, and achieve product\-market fit.
* Define satisfaction metrics through user feedback while navigating ambiguity to maintain enterprise standards and high\-impact delivery.

We are evolving our product portfolio across integration platforms, SaaS applications, data initiatives, and other digital capabilities. As that portfolio grows, we need a Technical Product Manager who can connect business needs to technical delivery — ensuring the products we build are not only strategically aligned, but also practical, measurable, and well\-adopted.


We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and engineering teams. You will translate business, operational, and technical requirements into clear product priorities, release plans, and acceptance criteria — and you will drive the adoption and continuous improvement of the products we deliver.

**What you will do**
--------------------


You will work closely with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, UX/UI Designers, QA, DevOps, business stakeholders, and leadership to shape the product direction and ensure delivery stays aligned to business outcomes.


In practice, that means you will turn strategic intent into a clear product roadmap, define well\-scoped backlog items, and help the team build products that are useful, usable, and measurable.

### **Define and prioritise product direction**

* Define and communicate the product vision aligned with business objectives.
* Maintain the product roadmap based on customer needs, market trends, and strategic priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
* Evaluate market trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to guide product direction.

### **Translate needs into delivery\-ready plans**

* Gather and analyse business requirements from customers and stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into clear features, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define product goals, success metrics, and release objectives.
* Prioritise the backlog using business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* Balance short\-term delivery with long\-term product strategy.

### **Own delivery and adoption**

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Work closely with Scrum teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Solution Architects to plan releases.
* Support user acceptance testing, production readiness, and post\-release adoption.

### **Product analytics**

* Define and monitor key performance indicators.
* Analyse product performance using customer feedback, usage metrics, and business data.
* Make data\-driven decisions for future enhancements.
* Track feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

### **Use data and AI to shape decisions**

* Evaluate AI\-powered features and capabilities for prioritisation within the product portfolio.

### **Collaborate across functions**

* Build strong relationships with customers, business leaders, and cross\-functional teams.

* Communicate product vision, roadmap, and release plans to stakeholders.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Cloud Infra, Marketing product teams, mobile app teams, program managers, business, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
* Ensure alignment across teams throughout the product lifecycle.

**What you bring**
------------------

### **Experience and Preferred Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, or Product Owner.
* Minimum 3 years of experience managing digital or software products.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams.
* Experience managing SaaS, cloud\-based, integration, or data\-focused products.
* Experience engaging multiple stakeholders, facilitating requirements sessions, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities.
* Experience managing enterprise software products, integration platforms, or notification/messaging systems.
* Experience managing data products, data engineering initiatives, or data analytics platforms and dashboards.
* Experience working in a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare product environment.
* Exposure to Quality Management Systems (QMS), particularly ISO 13485, and an understanding of how regulatory requirements shape product requirements, change control, and documentation practices.
* Professional certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner, or Pragmatic Institute certifications.

### **Technical skills**

* Product roadmap planning and product lifecycle management
* Release planning, product discovery, and requirements management
* Cloud\-native application architecture
* REST APIs, system integrations, and orchestration/middleware patterns
* Microsoft Azure fundamentals
* Web applications built with .NET and ReactJS
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture concepts
* Data engineering, data pipelines, and analytics platform concepts
* Identity, access management, and data governance fundamentals
* Software development lifecycle and DevOps / CI\-CD concepts

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
 This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
   

  

 Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
   

  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go\-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.
* You're the voice of the customer, from inside. You'll partner directly with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — evaluating new and pre\-GA capability under real operational load, documenting gaps with evidence, and tracking them to closure.
* You can carry the story upward. You'll represent this work in executive forums, translating implementation detail into the impact language leadership needs to make decisions.


 You'll spend part of your week across the table from business stakeholders shaping requirements, part with engineering getting it built, and part with Product shaping the roadmap. If you only want one of those three, this isn't the role.
   

  

**What You Get To Do**
**Shape the solution**
* Run discovery sessions with business stakeholders and process owners to understand current\-state pain, process gaps, and desired outcomes
* Translate business requirements into a recommended ServiceNow solution design, and pitch it credibly — including where out\-of\-box beats customization and where scope should be cut
* Drive alignment across competing stakeholders, secure sign\-off on scope and design decisions, and document the agreed solution


**Deliver it with engineering**
* Translate approved designs into deployable epics and stories with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and definition of done — well\-formed enough that engineering can build without guessing
* Walk engineering through design intent, defend the "why" behind decisions, and work through technical trade\-offs and constraints collaboratively as build progresses
* Act as the single point of translation between engineering and the business. When engineering needs clarification, you go get it — you own the round trip back to the business stakeholder rather than pulling engineers into stakeholder meetings to ask directly
* Manage scope, sequencing, and backlog priority with engineering through the build, and unblock decisions rather than escalating them
* Own UAT coordination, go\-live readiness, and hypercare
* Advise on platform best practices, upgrade\-safe design, and technical debt avoidance


**Measure it**
* Instrument every implementation for measurability from day one — define success metrics and baselines before build starts, not after go\-live
* Personally build and maintain the reports and dashboards that show whether the solution is actually delivering: adoption, deflection, cycle time, process compliance, data quality, and where the process is leaking
* Use the data to drive iteration — surface underperformance to stakeholders proactively, recommend fixes, and close the loop rather than declaring victory at deployment


**Accelerate it**
* Use AI tooling to compress delivery cycles — apply general\-purpose AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate requirements synthesis, data analysis, rapid prototyping of solution concepts for stakeholder validation, test case generation, and documentation — and bring a point of view on where AI genuinely speeds delivery versus where it adds noise


**Influence the product**
* Represent your work in executive forums like monthly product reviews: what you delivered, why that approach, and what measurable impact it created. Distill technical detail into outcome language a VP can act on
* Partner with ServiceNow Product Management for ITSM and ITOM — build durable working relationships with the teams building these products, evaluate new and pre\-GA capabilities in a real production environment, and provide grounded, constructive feedback based on actual adoption experience
* Own the product gap loop — document capability gaps that block or slow adoption, translate them into clear, evidence\-backed asks with business impact attached, and track them through to closure with Product and Engineering rather than logging them and moving on


**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8\+ years delivering ServiceNow solutions, with at least 3 full lifecycle ITSM and ITOM deployments owned end to end
* Prior product management experience, formal or informal
* Experience operating in an internal IT / Customer Zero model, deploying capability before general availability
* Exposure to enterprise CMDB remediation at scale

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

**What you will do**
--------------------


You will join our Software Excellence department, working at the intersection of operational analytics, incident management, and product quality. You will take ownership of analytical deliverables, contribute to data model development, and play an active role in shaping how operational intelligence is built and consumed.

### **Build and maintain analytical data models**

* Design and maintain dimensional models and semantic layers in Power BI or equivalent — including star schema structures, calculated measures, hierarchies, and row\-level security — following established architectural standards.
* Apply appropriate modelling patterns such as SCD and medallion layer conventions, and actively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks including query folding, cardinality issues, and incremental refresh configuration.
* Contribute to the definition and documentation of metrics and KPIs — specifying calculation logic, grain, and refresh cadence — and ensure consistent application across dashboards and reports.
* Work within the analytical architecture standards set by the Lead Data Analyst, and proactively flag opportunities to improve model quality, reusability, and maintainability.

### **Investigate operational signals and analyse data**

* Investigate operational and customer\-facing signals across multiple products and systems — combining data from telemetry, crash logs, support records, incident data, and observability platforms to surface patterns and root causes.
* Write complex, optimised SQL, Python, and KQL queries to extract, join, and analyse data from heterogeneous sources, and develop reusable scripts and templates that accelerate future investigations.
* Apply statistical techniques to detect anomalies, identify trends, and quantify product quality signals — including time\-series analysis, cohort analysis, and threshold\-based alerting.
* Support root cause investigations for significant incidents, contributing data\-driven findings and recommendations to cross\-functional teams.

### **Deliver BI solutions**

* Build and publish Power BI reports and dashboards that are performant, maintainable, and aligned to the organisation's BI deployment standards — including version control, environment promotion, and dataset certification practices.
* Optimise DAX measures and report\-level query performance, and apply visual\-level query reduction techniques to ensure a responsive user experience.
* Maintain analytical documentation — including measure definitions, report logic, and data source references — ensuring that solutions are understandable and auditable by others.
* Partner with Data Engineering to validate pipeline outputs and schema designs, and clearly articulate analytical data requirements when new or updated data products are needed.

### **Collaborate across functions**

* Work closely with Incident Management, Support, SRE Engineers, Software Development, and Data Engineering stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver relevant, trustworthy analytical outputs.
* Communicate findings clearly and adapt your message to different audiences — from engineers and domain experts to project managers and business stakeholders.
* Help ensure that data usage and retention practices are aligned with legal and compliance requirements, including GDPR.

**What you bring**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in a data\-focused role such as Data Analyst, BI Developer, Analytics Engineer, or equivalent.
* BE/B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* Solid hands\-on experience building and maintaining analytical data models in production — including star schema, semantic layers, and dimensional modelling.
* Proven track record of delivering analytical solutions across multiple data sources in a software\-driven environment.
* Experience working with defined metrics frameworks and contributing to their documentation and improvement.

### **Technical skills**

* Strong proficiency in SQL — including window functions, CTEs, query optimisation, and working with large datasets.
* Proficiency in Python for analytical work — including pandas, NumPy, and visualisation libraries.
* Solid hands\-on experience with Power BI — including DAX authoring, semantic model development, performance tuning, and report deployment.
* Proficiency in KQL for querying operational and telemetry data in Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Experience working with Databricks or equivalent platforms as an analytical consumer — querying Delta tables and using notebooks for exploratory work.
* Familiarity with Azure data services relevant to analytical consumption — including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics.
* Familiarity with distributed tracing concepts such as OpenTelemetry and how trace data relates to analytical outcomes.
* Understanding of statistical techniques applicable to operational analytics — anomaly detection, trend analysis, and time\-series methods.
* Good understanding of data privacy and GDPR principles as applied to analytical work.

jobs.description:
**About Parexel**
 Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights\-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000\+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient\-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
   

  

 We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry\-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
   

  

 Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
* Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
* Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
* Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost\-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
* Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
* Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
* Lead business analysis activities for medium to large\-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
* Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
* Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems


**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies
* Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences
* Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision\-making, and the ability to influence without authority
* Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* A patient\-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards


**Required Qualifications**
* 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry
* Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows
* Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)
* Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI\-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)
* Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and facilitating decision\-making

About OnArrival
 
 OnArrival is a travel technology company enabling banks, fintechs, and consumer platforms to offer seamless travel experiences through our technology infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Flights vertical and build reliable, scalable, and customer\-focused products. We want someone who is deeply comfortable using AI as part of everyday product work, not simply adding “AI\-powered” features to a roadmap.
 


 What You’ll Do
 * Own the Flights product roadmap from discovery through execution.
* Improve search, booking, payments, and post\-booking experiences.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, operations, and external partners.
* Use customer feedback, market insights, and product data to identify opportunities.
* Define requirements, prioritise initiatives, and drive products from concept to launch.
* Improve conversion, reliability, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Build scalable capabilities that can serve multiple enterprise customers.
* Track product performance and continuously improve key journeys.


 How We Expect You to Use AI
 
 At OnArrival, AI is part of how we work, think, and build. The ideal candidate should use AI meaningfully across the product lifecycle.
 



 You will be expected to:
 


* Use AI tools for research, competitive analysis, product discovery, and synthesising customer feedback.
* Analyse large volumes of support conversations, operational issues, and user behaviour to uncover patterns and opportunities.
* Create product specifications, user flows, edge\-case matrices, prototypes, and test scenarios faster and with greater depth.
* Use AI\-assisted prototyping and coding tools to validate ideas before committing significant engineering effort.
* Work with data and engineering teams to query, interpret, and visualise product data.
* Evaluate where AI can genuinely simplify customer journeys, reduce manual work, or improve decision\-making.
* Understand the practical strengths and limitations of LLMs, including hallucinations, latency, cost, privacy, evaluation, and human oversight.
* Define clear success metrics and evaluation frameworks for AI\-enabled product experiences.
* Think beyond chat interfaces and identify opportunities for intelligent recommendations, automation, personalisation, and agent\-led actions.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and help improve how the wider product organisation operates.



 You do not need to be an ML engineer. However, you should be technically curious, comfortable experimenting independently, and capable of working closely with engineering teams to turn AI possibilities into reliable products.
 


 What We’re Looking For
 * 6–10 years of product management experience.
* Prior experience in flights, airlines, OTAs, travel technology, or a closely related domain.
* Strong understanding of flight search, booking, ticketing, and post\-booking journeys.
* Experience working with airline, GDS, NDC, or travel\-supplier integrations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and product execution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering and understand API\-based products.
* Hands\-on experience using modern AI tools in day\-to\-day product work.
* Ability to distinguish meaningful AI applications from features driven purely by hype.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong ownership and comfort working through ambiguity.


 Good to Have
 * Experience building B2B, B2B2C, embedded, or platform products.
* Exposure to payments, refunds, reconciliation, or travel operations.
* Experience with SQL, analytics platforms, experimentation, or rapid prototyping.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, AI agents, prompt design, retrieval systems, or AI product evaluation.
* Experience launching an AI\-enabled customer or internal product.


 Why Join Us
 * Own a critical product vertical with significant business impact.
* Solve complex problems across travel, technology, commerce, and AI.
* Build products used by leading consumer platforms and their customers.
* Work closely with the founders and a strong cross\-functional team.
* Operate in a culture where product managers are expected to think, prototype, analyse, and execute.
* Help shape the next generation of embedded and intelligent travel experiences.
* If you understand flights deeply, think clearly about products, and already use AI to work faster and better, we would love to hear from you.

**JLL Technologies**
**Product Manager, Smart Building Platform**
**Team**
 Workplace Management Product
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 JLL manages real estate for some of the world’s largest organizations. Behind the scenes, a small product team is rebuilding how that work happens — replacing disconnected building systems, reactive maintenance cycles, and siloed sensor data with unified operational intelligence and AI\-powered workflows.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of that shift. As PM for the Smart Building Platform, you will own a next\-generation product that unifies building systems, IoT data streams, and operational analytics to help clients achieve breakthrough gains in efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience — across portfolios that span millions of square feet.
   

  

 A defining part of this role is knowing how to operate at the edge of first\- and third\-party product boundaries: building systems, IoT protocols, and CMMS integrations are rarely clean. You will be the person who defines where JLL’s platform ends and where a vendor’s capability begins — and then builds the right thing in the right place.
   

  

**What makes this role unusual:**
 You are PM for the Smart Building Platform — which means real ownership, not a sub\-feature. You will set the roadmap, write the requirements, and be accountable for outcomes.
   

  

 The AI work here is live, not aspirational. Agentic workflows on MCP architecture, NLQ interfaces into building data, and AI\-accelerated prototyping are active investment areas — not backlog items.
   

  

 Third\-party building systems are not black boxes here. You will own the integration strategy for BMS, IoT, and CMMS platforms with the rigor of a first\-party product owner.
   

  

**What You Will Work On**
**Smart Building Platform strategy and roadmap**
 You will own the product roadmap for the Smart Building Platform, balancing near\-term delivery against long\-term strategic vision. That means translating client needs, market signals, and business objectives into a prioritized backlog — and defending those priorities with data. You will ensure the platform stays tightly aligned with JLL’s WPM delivery infrastructure and revenue goals, and evolve the roadmap as the IoT and AI landscape shifts underneath it.
   

  

**Building systems and IoT integration**
 Smart building products live or die on integration depth. You will define the integration strategy for building management systems (BMS/BAS), IoT sensor platforms, and CMMS systems — owning the specs that bridge protocols like BACnet and Modbus with JLL’s data layer. You will work closely with engineering to ensure the platform surfaces building system data in ways that are actionable, not just visible.
   

  

**AI and agentic product development**
 Workplace OS is JLL’s agentic platform, built on MCP architecture and natural language query capabilities. Your job is to define what Smart Building agents should do, and then build and ship them. That includes agents that reach into building systems to retrieve operational data, surface anomalies before they become incidents, and route work automatically based on real\-time conditions.
   

  

 This means building working AI prototypes — not just writing specs — to validate ideas quickly before engineering commitment. It means using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, and similar LLMs) as a daily productivity multiplier: synthesizing discovery findings, stress\-testing requirements. And it means knowing the difference between a demo and a workflow\-grade capability.
   

  

**Requirements, Specs, And Delivery**
 You will define high\-quality product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using AI tools with designers to accelerate drafting, iteration, and engineering handoff.
   

  

 Your requirements are not long drawn\-out documents but real working prototypes that you would have built along side your users. You will then work with engineering to bring those to production.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering and program managers through the full planning\-to\-release lifecycle, and define the success metrics that determine whether what shipped actually worked.
   

  

**Cross\-functional leadership**
 You will build and maintain strong working relationships with engineering, program management, operations, sales, and client success. You will represent the platform in executive reviews, client conversations, and external forums. You will navigate ambiguity confidently, making well\-reasoned decisions with incomplete information when the moment requires it.
   

  

**How You Will Spend Your Time**
 No two weeks look identical, but across a typical quarter you will be:
   

  

* Owning and prioritizing the Smart Building Platform roadmap, translating stakeholder input and discovery findings into a clear product direction that engineering can execute against
* Running discovery sessions with facilities teams, implementation leads, and enterprise clients to surface workflow pain and validate product direction
* Writing integration specs for BMS, IoT, and CMMS connections, with enough technical depth to lead the engineering conversation
* Building AI prototypes in collaboration with engineering — using LLM tooling and MCP integrations to validate use cases before committing to a full build
* Using AI tools fluently in your daily workflow: generating first drafts of PRDs, synthesizing research, producing competitive analyses, and accelerating design collaboration
* Defining KPIs and success metrics for every initiative, and communicating outcomes clearly to product leadership and client stakeholders
* Acting as the connective tissue between building operations teams, IoT/BMS engineering, and the data and AI platform organization

 KJBN Labs is building Raithu, an AgriTech platform that helps agricultural companies gain complete control over their production and operations. By leveraging technology and data\-driven insights, Raithu supports smarter decision\-making across the agricultural value chain. Team members at KJBN Labs work on impactful solutions that directly support the growth and resilience of agri companies.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Senior Product Manager role at KJBN Labs is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for defining the product vision and strategy for Raithu, aligning it with customer needs and business objectives. Day\-to\-day activities include gathering and prioritizing requirements, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams, and managing the product roadmap. The Senior Product Manager will analyze market and user data, run discovery and validation experiments, and translate insights into clear product specifications. The role also involves leading cross\-functional initiatives, tracking product performance, and continuously improving features to enhance customer value.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Product management experience in tech or SaaS environments, including owning roadmaps, defining requirements, and shipping products end\-to\-end.
* Strong skills in user research, data analysis, and market assessment to inform product decisions and measure outcomes.
* Proficiency in cross\-functional collaboration, working closely with engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with agile methodologies, backlog management, and iterative product development.
* Ability to translate complex operational workflows into intuitive product experiences, ideally in AgriTech, supply chain, or B2B platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
* Demonstrated leadership in mentoring product teams and driving strategic initiatives.

 That's the product problem at KJBN Labs.

The ideal candidate will bring executive presence, strong vendor management discipline, and the ability to coach and groom a high\-performing team that delivers measurable improvements in payment performance within the first 12 months.


As Pebl’s most senior payments operator, you are accountable for ensuring timely and accurate money movement and reconciliation. Along with Treasury, Procurement and Finance, you will be a part of leadership cohorts that will design and build Pebl’s global payments strategy.

**How You'll Make An Impact:**

* Act as the business owner for payments performance and employees experience, partnering closely with Payroll, Accounting, Treasury and Product.
* Drive a “customer” oriented payments journey, ensuring speed, reliability, and ease of use across all touchpoints.
* Partner with Accounting and FP\&A in driving cash forecast goals.
* Hold internal business partners accountable to performance SLAs, cut off deadline, accuracy, speed and reliability over payment needs
* Lead Payment Operations, identifying and resolving friction points across the end\-to\-end user journey
* Drive operational improvements in exceptions, retries, reversals, and escalations

**Let's Connect If You Have:**

* Masters in Finance / Commerce BA/BS in Accounting/Finance or equivalent working experience required
* 7\-10 years of relevant experience in heading global payment operations, vendor management, and accounts payable.
* Accounting experience is preferred, particularly in accounts payable, accrual and departmental cost center reporting.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills,
* Ability to work with a wider global team and across different time zones if required.
* Technology\-savvy, including Microsoft Suite, NetSuite and ZIP is desirable.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with ability to prioritize and juggle with a variety of tasks
* Assist in ME close by collaborating with GL, Treasury and the International Accounting team ensuring timely closure of books

**Our Commitment to You**


At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:

* **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge.
* **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families.

Please visit our career page for more information.

We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. ### **About Norstella**

  

 Norstella is a premier and critical global life sciences data and AI solutions provider dedicated to improving patient access to life\-saving therapies. Norstella supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies across the full drug development lifecycle — from pipeline to patient. Our mission is simple: to help our clients bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently, ultimately impacting patient lives.  

  

Norstella unites market\-leading brands \- Citeline, Evaluate, MMIT, Panalgo, Skipta and The Dedham Group and delivers must\-have answers and insights, leveraging AI, for critical strategic, clinical, and commercial decision\-making. We help our clients:  

* Accelerate the drug development cycle
* Assess competition and bring the right drugs to market
* Make data driven commercial and financial decisions
* Match and recruit patients for clinical trials
* Identify and address barriers to therapies


  

Norstella serves most pharmaceutical and biotech companies around the world, along with regulators like the FDA, and payers. By providing critical proprietary data supporting AI\-driven workflows, Norstella helps clients make decisions faster and with greater confidence. Norstella’s investments in AI are transforming how data is consumed and decisions are made, disrupting inefficient legacy workflows and helping the industry become more efficient, innovative, and responsive to patient needs.

* Establish coding, configuration, and naming standards, and enforce best practices across the platforms.

* Own the day\-to\-day configuration of both Data Cloud (Data 360\) and Marketing Cloud Engagement.
* Customize standard and custom objects, fields, data extensions, and data model objects to meet evolving business needs.
* Implement and maintain security controls, including user roles, profiles, permissions, sharing, and business unit access.

jobs.title: Member Success Associate (Support)
jobs.description:
**About Sahamati Foundation**
  

Sahamati is the RBI\-recognised Self\-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) for India’s Account Aggregator ecosystem, a cross\-sectoral industry alliance built to advance consent\-based financial data sharing.


As a not\-for\-profit industry alliance, we work closely with regulated entities, technology providers, and ecosystem participants to promote secure and consent\-driven data sharing under the AA framework.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


Sahamati’s support portal is the ecosystem’s designated channel for resolving disputes between Regulated Entities (RE) — AAs, FIPs, and FIUs. The vision is straightforward: REs should be able to raise, track, and close inter\-RE issues with minimal intervention from Sahamati. As Member Success Associate, you are responsible for making that vision real. You will own RE relationships on ecosystem issues, drive portal adoption with Sahamati Members, and serve as the escalation layer when disputes need a sharper eye. This is a role for someone who understands how the AA framework works in practice — not in theory — and can operate with authority across relationship management, product ownership, and executive reporting.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Own the RE relationship on ecosystem issues — and be the last resort, not the first call.**
  

You will build and maintain Sahamati’s relationships with member REs specifically around ecosystem issues and dispute resolution. Your goal is an ecosystem where REs resolve disputes through the portal on their own — and that only happens if they trust it. You will drive portal adoption through member sessions, and proactive engagement, particularly with FIPs where participation in dispute resolution is critical to ecosystem health. When the portal hasn’t resolved an issue, you step in — but with a diagnostic lens. You need to understand AA API workflows well enough to form an independent view of what went wrong, not just facilitate a conversation between parties.


**Own the support portal as a product — and make it better every quarter.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------


You are the product owner of Sahamati’s support portal. Your experience handling escalations and working with REs gives you a ground\-level view of where the portal falls short — and it is your responsibility to turn that into a feature roadmap. You will work with the Sahamati tech team to prioritise and drive enhancements, with the bar being simple: better workflows, fewer escalations, more disputes resolved within the ecosystem. You will also own internal reporting to Sahamati’s leadership, giving them a clear and honest picture of ecosystem health — adoption trends, dispute patterns, and where friction remains.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------


You have 8–10 years in fintech or financial services, and you’ve spent a meaningful part of that time working directly with external partners — not just internally. You’re technically fluent enough to read an API and form a view, and senior enough to know when to escalate and when to hold the line.


* Deep familiarity with AA API workflows and consent\-based data sharing — you can diagnose an inter\-RE dispute, not just describe it.
* Experience in partner or ecosystem\-facing roles where you’ve owned relationships, not just managed them.
* Exposure to product ownership, BRD writing, or SDLC — you’ve shaped tools, not just used them.
* Understanding of financial domain use cases (lending, wealth, insurance) relevant to the AA ecosystem.
* Prior exposure to Zoho Creator or a comparable support platform is a plus, as is direct experience with the AA framework or ReBIT specifications.
**Why Join Us**
---------------


* Opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, finance, and policy in one of India’s most transformative digital ecosystems.
* Exposure to leading financial institutions, regulators, and innovators shaping the future of consent\-based data sharing.
* A collaborative and purpose\-driven work environment that values initiative and learning.
* A platform to work with senior leaders from across banks, fintechs, and regulated institutions in the BFSI sector
**How To Apply**
----------------


Join us in our mission to promote financial inclusion and empower individuals across India through the Account Aggregator ecosystem. Apply now to become a part of our dedicated team!


Please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@sahamati.org.in . Please indicate “Member Services Associate – Support ” in the subject line. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis, till an appropriate candidate is finalized.


**Location:** Bengaluru (On\-site)
  

**Department:** Member Success
  

**Reporting to:** Lead, Member Success

jobs.title: Head of Operations - Instawork Robotics Labs
jobs.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**



Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” \- the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments \- kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes \- to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.


### **Build. Scale. Operate.**



We’re looking for a hardcore operations leader who thrives in the real world — someone who has built and scaled large, distributed operations from the ground up and knows what it takes to turn an idea into an operation that actually works.



This is not a role for someone who only manages dashboards, processes, or strategy decks.



We’re looking for a builder and operator, someone who can start with a blank sheet of paper, build the team, design the processes, solve problems on the ground, and scale the operation without losing speed or quality.



You’ll be operating in an environment where things change quickly, the problems are often ambiguous, and there is rarely a playbook to follow.


### **What You’ll Do**


* **Build and scale operations from the ground up** — define the operating model, build processes, hire teams, establish metrics, and create the systems needed to scale.
* **Own large, distributed, real\-world operations** across multiple locations, teams, and workflows.
* **Build high\-performing teams** — hire exceptional operators, develop leaders, set a high bar for execution, and create a culture of ownership and accountability.
* **Turn chaos into structure** — identify operational bottlenecks, build repeatable processes, and continuously improve how the organization operates.
* **Be relentlessly execution\-oriented** — when something breaks, you don’t wait for someone else to solve it. You get to the ground, understand the problem, and figure it out.
* **Operate at speed** — priorities will change, plans will move, and unexpected problems will come up. You’ll need to make decisions quickly and keep the team moving.
* **Build for scale** — design processes and teams that can handle 10x growth, not just solve today’s problem.
* **Own outcomes, not just activities** — set clear operational metrics and relentlessly drive performance, quality, productivity, and efficiency.

### **What We’re Looking For**


**You’ve built before.**


* 12\+ years of experince in Operations
* Significant experience building and running large, distributed, real\-world operations.
* Experience in e\-commerce, logistics, marketplaces, field operations, fast\-scaling startups, hardware\-adjacent businesses, or other operationally intensive environments.
* A track record of building teams and operating models from scratch, not just inheriting established ones.
* Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build teams that are highly accountable, ambitious, and deeply committed to the mission.
* Extremely high ownership — you naturally think, **“I’ll figure it out.”**
* **Extreme agility and resilience.**

Plans change* + you adapt, rather than freeze.
	
	Pressure increases+ you become clearer and more decisive.
	
	Something breaks+ you go after the root cause.
* Strong operational judgment — you know when to build a process, when to break one, and when to simply get things done.
* Comfortable working with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for perfect data.
* A strong bias toward action, with the ability to balance speed, quality, cost, and scale.

### **The Kind of Leader We Want**



You’re the person who:


* Can walk into a messy operation and figure out what needs to happen next.
* Has built teams from a handful of people into large, high\-performing organizations.
* Can spend the morning looking at operational metrics and the afternoon solving a problem on the ground.
* Doesn’t need a perfect org structure or playbook to get started.
* Sets an extremely high bar — but earns trust by giving the team the support, context, and ownership to meet it.
* Builds teams that want to run through walls for them.
* Is calm when things are chaotic and gets more focused when the pressure goes up.
* Gets excited by operational complexity rather than intimidated by it.
* Has experience with robotics, AI data collection, or hardware operations

### **Bonus, Not Required**



Experience or exposure to:


* Supply chain or manufacturing operations
* Field workforce operations
* Marketplace operations
* Multi\-city / multi\-location scaling
* Building operations in an early\-stage or rapidly scaling startup
 **Our Values**


* **Empathy, Trust \& Candor**  

We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  

We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!

We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Have you ever wanted to be part of a team that builds highly efficient system for E\-reader?
  

Are you looking at creating value for millions of customers as we launch more E\-readers with additional capabilities? Do you want to work at a company where you are the owner, where you are encouraged to build, and where you have the autonomy to push boundaries? Do you have a passion for designing system that is an enabler for builders that create applications on top of it? This describes your daily journey. Are you ready? Then join us!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will own adding capabilities as we unlock more features on Kindle E\-reader family. Our goal is to make it fast, easy and low\-cost for our internal application developers to build features and release them on our E\-reader stack.
  

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams across Amazon.  

You should be comfortable with a level of depth that you need to dive into as we solve deep operating system level problems! We will need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: software, hardware as well as automation.  

You design and develop the critical components in the operating system as well as low\-level components in E\-reader that make the product a performant, secure and power optimized device. You also write applications on top of our unique Kindle Operating system.
  

Along the way you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

* You are proficient in C/C\+\+ to understand internals of E\-reader. If you know React Native, it will be a bonus as you can also write applications in E\-reader.
* Collaborate with experienced Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative components in E\-reader
* Architect and design a secure software that protects customer data stored on the devices.

  

A day in the life  

In this role, you will be actively engaged in developing our system and writing applications that are based on C/C\+\+ and react native. You will also be a lead engineer guiding junior members in this role.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will work closely with customer service stakeholders, architects, business analysts, developers and operations teams to define, prioritize and deliver scalable omnichannel solutions that enhance customer experience, improve agent productivity and support global standardization across Siemens Healthineers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage the product backlog for Genesys Cloud and related contact center capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs and global transformation objectives.
* Define product vision, roadmap and release priorities for contact center features including routing, IVR, digital channels, reporting, workforce optimization and integrations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, regional teams and technical experts to gather requirements, refine user stories and translate strategic goals into actionable delivery plans.
* Prioritize demand, change requests and technical enablers based on business value, operational impact, compliance needs and platform scalability.
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to ensure solution design decisions are feasible, supportable and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning and acceptance activities, and provide timely decisions to unblock delivery teams.
* Track product performance, adoption and operational outcomes using KPIs, analytics and stakeholder feedback, and continuously improving the platform roadmap.
* Support go\-live planning, rollout readiness, change communication and post\-production stabilization for new Genesys capabilities and enhancements.


**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Strong experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar role in contact center transformation, customer service technology or digital product delivery.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Genesys Cloud or contact center application capabilities such as queues, routing, IVR, digital channels, reporting, user/role management and platform configuration concepts.
* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria and prioritization techniques.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to align business, operations and technical teams across regions and time zones.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess business value, operational trade\-offs, risks and dependencies in a complex enterprise environment.
* Experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar platforms for backlog management, release planning and delivery tracking.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a strong focus on service experience, process simplification, adoption and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong passion to drive a product – Defining a clear, long\-term goal and roadmap for what the product will achieve.
* Exposure \& experience to AI capabilities for contact center setup


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in product ownership, business transformation or contact center technology delivery in a global enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience with omnichannel contact center solutions and a solid understanding of customer service operations, call flows and service processes.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams spanning business, architecture, development, testing and operations.
* Knowledge of integration with adjacent enterprise platforms such as CRM, reporting, workforce management or automation tools is an advantage.
* Experience working in global programs with distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.

 Hands on experience with Snowflake or Azure data engineering.

**To be a successful Engineering Manager, you should have experience with:**

**Purpose of the role**
 The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade\-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub\-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.

* Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
* Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end\-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
* Acceptance Criteria Definition \& Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed\-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
* Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on\-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.
